title: Two-finger rod gripper (SO-101 demo)
brief: Design fingertips for a two-finger parallel gripper (like the SO-101 arm's) that grip round rods. ONE assembly graph for every rod size in the catalogue, in two poses: open (closing = 0) and closed (closing = 1). Bodies: 'rod' (a cylinder of Ø rod_d, length rod_len, on the z axis, centred at z=0), 'jaw_r' and 'jaw_l' (fingertip pads that close along x from either side; jaw_l is jaw_r mirrored, e.g. a move with rot_z 180). Each jaw has a V-groove facing the rod so the rod self-centres. In the closed pose both jaws must touch the rod with no interference and keep a gap between each other; in the open pose each jaw opens by 'stroke' and must leave clearance for the rod to go in.

checks.rule: closed: right jaw touches the rod
closed: left jaw touches the rod
closed: right jaw does not cut into the rod
closed: left jaw does not cut into the rod
closed: the jaws keep at least 2 mm between them (they must close on the rod, not on each other)
open: at least 2 mm between the right jaw and the rod
open: at least 2 mm between the left jaw and the rod
